# Unstated order is an order

`customer_support.heu.queue_management.unstated_order_is_an_order` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> If work selection is not defined, it is defined anyway — by whoever is on shift.


## The heuristic

**If work selection is not defined, it is defined anyway — by whoever is on shift.**


_Why:_ Nobody works from a random position in a list. Absent a policy, each agent applies the one that serves them, and the aggregate is reliably oldest-last.
